judged.play: Creator hype-talks his team during the halftime break showing a 10-2 score.
judged.line: You got this on defense, man.
judged.reason: Just an intermission pep talk with no actual gameplay action.

judged.play: 100 Thieves secures a clutch round win on defense to extend their lead to 11-2.
judged.reason: Solid clutch round win with a standing flex reaction, though outshined by the map finish.

judged.play: Replay shows Bang clutching a round while surviving on just 1 HP.
judged.reason: An impressive 1 HP clutch highlight replay that triggers a passionate flex celebration.

judged.play: 100 Thieves wins another round to reach map point at 12-2.
judged.line: Too easy! Get him out of here!
judged.reason: Standard round win callout that lacks the top-tier energy of the final winning round.

judged.play: 100 Thieves shuts down the enemy push to win the map 13-2 in dominant fashion.
judged.reason: The decisive map-winning play featuring the creator's peak laugh and head-in-hands reaction.

judged.play: 100 Thieves players walk off stage after winning as victory graphics display.
judged.reason: Post-match stage reaction without any live gameplay.

judged.play: Post-game scoreboard displays player stats before transitioning into a promotional video.
judged.line: We make it look too easy, bro!
judged.reason: Out-of-game scoreboard viewing and commercial playback.
